title: Allow configuring the StatsD Deployment update strategy
body:
Allow users to configure the StatsD Deployment's update strategy through `statsd.strategy`, instead of relying on Kubernetes defaults.

Set explicit defaults of `RollingUpdate`, `maxUnavailable: 0`, and `maxSurge: 1`. Add the configuration to the values schema and render it in the Deployment template.

Cover the default strategy and custom rollout limits in chart tests. Use non-default values in the override test to verify that custom configuration is honored.

### Validation

- Ruff formatting and lint checks passed.
- Helm rendering confirmed the default and custom rollout limits.
- Pytest was not run because Breeze is unavailable locally.

@@ -2578,6 +2578,13 @@ statsd:

   configMapAnnotations: {}
 
+  # Update strategy for the StatsD Deployment
+  strategy:
+    type: RollingUpdate
+    rollingUpdate:

+      maxSurge: 1
